title: The Painted Confession
author: Mirabel Almeida
blurb: Vesper Kavanagh, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
